core_principles.statement: RootOrchestrator is the cognitive authority of the local system and the only entity allowed to produce FinalOutput.
Code substrate enforces schemas, time, DRS IO, budgets, hooks, persistence, and invariants. It does not replace Root cognition.
A vassal's vassal is not Root's vassal. Parent clusters set boundary conditions and evaluate returned snapshots, but do not micromanage nested internal trajectories.
Before generating a plan, the system must attempt local memory / DRS retrieval with TemporalQuery.
Time is a mandatory axis of truth, retrieval, decay, and validity. Every DRSRecord requires TimeEnvelope.
Work, Thoughts, UP, Quarantine, and DeadEnds are separate epistemic layers and must not be silently merged.
Internal exchange is structured JSON objects. Prose is output rendering, not the primary internal substrate.
AVF builds a viability field and AttractorPacket before Architect receives the task.
GTValidator runs after Post V&V and before Root FinalOutput.
Only RootOrchestrator may convert FinalDraftProposal into FinalOutput.
Marennya and UP artifacts are written to Quarantine before promotion.

orchestrator_stage.name: Root-controlled Orchestrator Stage

gt_validator.note: GT does not prove truth. It selects robust strategy under payoff specification.

responsibilities: summarize selected completed, needs_user, and blocked branches
final_renderer.note: FinalRenderer is subordinate to Root. It drafts FinalDraftProposal only.

world_state.description: Root-assembled state of the world before Architect: time, user context, session context, DRS summaries, active policy and relevant memory pointers.

temporal_query.description: Mandatory retrieval time filter with as_of, time_range and freshness_bias.

time_envelope.description: Mandatory time vector for DRS records: PT, KT, ET, CT and TTL.

candidate_vector.description: Pre-plan direction of possible solution. Generated by needles, DRS records, external pointers, or fallback templates.

attractor_packet.description: AVF output passed to Architect: viable vectors, forbidden regions, budgets, time assumptions and instructions.

plan_graph.description: Architect output: DAG/chain/tree/mixed plan with node dependencies and executor assignments.

result_proposal.description: Executor output candidate. Not a final answer.

gt_report.description: GTValidator output: winner/mix, payoff, ratings, regret, half-life, decision.

final_output.description: User-facing output created only by RootOrchestrator.

final_draft_proposal.description: Subordinate renderer draft. Not a FinalOutput.

drs_record.description: Local DRS registry record with layer, pointer/summary/content stub, TimeEnvelope, provenance, access metadata, and optional GT metadata.

needle.description: Configurable module declaring capabilities, vectors, contracts, policies and metadata.

fractal_dag_executor.description: Root-controlled executor runner positioned after Architect PlanGraph and before ResultProposals. It executes PlanGraph dependencies, computes ready sets, respects parallelism and max_nodes limits, detects cycles, returns ResultProposal-shaped outputs and child boundary snapshots, and never creates FinalOutput or global commit.

viability_feedback.description: Feedback from actual outcomes to future AVF scoring.

PT.name: Physical Time
PT.description: System/clock time when record was created or observed.

KT.name: Knowledge Time
KT.description: As-of time: when knowledge is considered valid or known.

ET.name: Event Time
ET.description: Time when domain event happened, if applicable.

execution_router.purpose: Select the cheapest safe execution mode instead of forcing every request through the full cognitive pipeline.
execution_router.reason: The default v0.25 demo intentionally exercises the full pipeline to prove contracts and invariants. The direct_reuse CLI scenario is an explicit shortcut test path, not the default.

levels.description: Ready needle, known safe deterministic action, no Architect, no heavy LLM.
Fresh trusted DRS record or protocol replay through explicit Root shortcut logic.
levels.skip_allowed_only_if: Explicit RootFinalFromReuse or direct protocol shortcut exists and tests prove Architect and Executor were skipped legally.

levels.description: Prior records found, but shortcut not allowed. Full or partial pipeline may run with constrained context.
AVF selects CandidateVectors and creates AttractorPacket; Architect creates PlanGraph for tasks needing planning without full deep branching.
Multiple branches, Executors, Post V&V, GT selection, and full DRS writeback for novel, ambiguous, high-risk, high-value, or multi-path tasks.
Marennya, UP, deep research, idle validation, scheduled or deferred work outside the immediate response critical path unless explicitly requested.

invariants: Full pipeline must be available but not mandatory.
No DRS retrieval without TemporalQuery in any execution mode.
L0 and L1 paths must not bypass safety, policy, permission, audit, or required DRS writeback.
A DRS hit is not direct reuse by itself.
retrieved_records > 0 only permits memory_context_applied by default.
Direct reuse requires explicit Root shortcut logic.
Direct reuse must not be implemented by accident.
Tests for direct reuse must prove Architect and Executor were skipped.
Direct external or action execution must respect policy, access control, audit, and DRS writeback.
L5 deferred reflection must not block immediate user response unless explicitly requested.

drs.resolver_note: Pointer resolution is not implemented in MVP LocalDRS. LocalDRS validates pointer shape and stores pointer metadata only.

principles: Production should use Credential Vault / sealed secret slots.
DRS stores references, scopes, provenance, access policy, and audit metadata, not raw secrets.
LLM/SLM components may reason over existence, type, scope, and permission state without seeing raw secret values.

work.description: Canonical task outcomes, accepted facts, final decisions, successful and failed execution results.

thoughts.description: Validated Marennya reflections, patches, lessons and intradomain improvements.

up.description: Validated UP opportunities, protocol templates and cross-domain links.

deadends.description: Negative experience, forbidden/failed paths, invalidated approaches and conditions.

formula.feature_vector: x_i = [rel_i, p_i, utility_i, cost_i, risk_i, time_i, conflict_i, gt_i, novelty_i]

payoff_formula.formula: Payoff = w1*U + w2*R - w3*C - w4*V + w5*Tr + w6*N

payoff_v0_2_design.principle: GT is not TruthProof. GT selects the most viable candidate under explicit payoff and policy constraints.
payoff_v0_2_design.conceptual_formula: payoff_v0_2 = base_payoff_v0_1 + avf_viability_bonus + primary_path_bonus + reuse_potential_bonus + evidence_strength_bonus - fallback_role_penalty - human_burden_penalty - dependency_depth_penalty - risk_level_penalty

gt_ttl.half_life_formula: half_life = base * sigmoid((Elo - mu) / s) * (1 - normalized_regret) * freshness_boost

marenna.description: Reflective/internal-improvement systemic needle. It is not an ordinary external action needle and does not gain sovereignty.

forbidden_simplifications: Do not reduce the project to a chatbot.
Do not allow Executor to create FinalOutput.
Do not merge Work, Thoughts and UP layers.
Do not calculate AVF by free-form LLM reasoning.
Do not implement real external APIs in MVP.
Do not start with UI before invariant tests pass.
allowed_simplifications_for_mvp: MVP LocalDRS may use local JSON files as a registry store for pointer-first records and small non-secret inline demo content.
External DRS may be mocked or disabled.
GTValidator may use simple payoff and Elo.
Marennya and UP validation may be stubbed as explicit six-stage pipeline.
Needles may be static JSON files.
success_criteria: Reuse scenario uses DRS records from prior run.
Forbidden vector is blocked by AVF before Architect.
Root creates FinalOutput only after Post V&V and GT.
DRS writeback creates Work record with TimeEnvelope and GT metadata.
Second run demonstrates memory-informed behavior through DRS retrieval, lineage, reuse/context metadata, or controlled direct reuse when explicitly enabled.
Future demos should additionally prove improved vector scoring, dead-end avoidance, and GT/TTL convergence.
